notes.title: ONE LAST BREATH is now available!
notes.content:
One Last Breath invites you to unlock the power of nature to navigate through a dying Earth, while challenging your mind with intricate puzzles and thrilling escapes from perilous foes. Experience a unique blend of despair and hope, brutality and beauty, in a game that not only entertains but also reflects on our relationship with the planet.

Enjoy the game, and take care of the planet.

PD: If you enjoy the game, don't forget to put a review and talk with us in the community hub.

notes.title: ONE DAY LEFT to SAVE THE EARTH
notes.content:
Hi!

Tomorrow will be a big day for the earth.

After many years of work, One Last Breath will finally be available. Take control of Gaia and save the planet, you are the last hope!

One Last Breath is a 2.5D platformer/puzzler wherein you play as Gaia, an earth goddess born from mother nature’s very last breath. Thrust into existence in a post-apocalyptic earth where mankind has all but vanished, it’s up to Gaia to restore life back to the planet. But be forewarned, as decades of pollution and greed have twisted the land into a hostile ruin full of deadly aberrations.

Thank you very much to the community, who have been supporting us during all this time. We hope you all can enjoy the game.

notes.title: Demo Shutdown on 13th Tuesday
notes.content:
As you have read on the title, we are shutting the demo down tomorrow 13th and the entire team would love to talk to you more about it, but first of all the most important thing: [u][b]WE KEEP DEVELOPING THE GAME.
[/b][/u]

We have been developing One Last Breath for 2 years now and it's been a wild ride. We love One last Breath and we love what we are building. This game borned from the bottom of our hearts. 

It's been 1 year now since we started going around different videogame events showing for the first time a demo to the player and the feedback has been amazing always. The support that everyone is giving to Gaia has always amazed to the team. So happened when we published the demo on Steam 6 months ago. We can not be more happy about your feelings towards the game, seriosly. [i]We even won the "Best Game Award" at Gamescom's Indie Arena Booth. 
[/i]
We are so happy about the demo and what the team accomplished with it, but let's be clear: the demo was developed on February 2022, and it has been a while since that. The demo was developed with no budget.

The most important thing that happened since then is that we went from a "no-budget studio" to "proffesional studio" that has financial support. This is huge obviously and we were able to hire more people if needed and fill development holes. That happened also. The team grown up.

[b]We listen to our fans.[/b] The game has evolved a lot in a really, really good way. It has improved enormously.  We look at the public demo and even if we are so proud about what we accomplished back at those days with no budget, we feel uncomfortable having that due to it doesn't represent the current quality of the game nor the final quality the game will have. 

That is why we decided that Gaia needs some rest by now. She will be back and we are sure that you are going to love it. We keep developing. [b]We keep doing what we know we love.[/b]

Gaia will comeback soon and we will have more news in the next weeks, so if you don't want to miss them, follow us on our socials. 

Thanks for your understanding.
